decisions.reason: As a close-to-core carpet with modest carrying cost, it remains worth keeping, though another year without clear differentiation makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than before.

The corner bench uses established capabilities but serves a more specific use case, so it is still viable to keep while testing demand, albeit with a relatively elevated exit risk.
